source_document_text:
COMPLAINT FOR BREACH OF WRITTEN SUPPLY AGREEMENT
Plaintiff Morrow Vale Components LLC alleges that it entered into a written supply agreement with defendant Tern Harbor Kitchens, Inc. on January 8, 2024. Under the agreement, Morrow Vale was to supply custom cabinet fittings, and Tern Harbor was to pay the invoiced price within 30 days of delivery. Morrow Vale delivered the ordered goods on March 4 and March 18, 2024, and Tern Harbor accepted both deliveries without objection. Morrow Vale issued invoices totaling $84,600. Tern Harbor paid $20,000 on April 10, 2024, which Morrow Vale applied to the account, leaving $64,600 unpaid. Morrow Vale sent a written demand for the remaining balance on May 2, 2024, but Tern Harbor has not paid it. The agreement provides for interest on overdue balances at 1% per month and reasonable attorneys' fees and costs incurred to collect amounts due. Morrow Vale requests judgment for the $64,600 principal balance, contractual interest from the applicable due dates, and reasonable attorneys' fees and costs.
